reviewer: Codex agent visual inspection, not new human approval
scope: All 16 contact sheets, seven predetermined paired instants each, decoded sequentially from eight original recordings. No claim to have watched every intervening frame.

demo_0001.observation: Initial block upper-left and oblique; fingers surround it before a lifted transport over the square; the hand withdraws and the upright block remains.
demo_0001.limit: Support forces, exact contact/release time and metric lift height are not measured.

demo_0002.observation: Initial block left/oblique; held transfer to square followed by withdrawal and upright final placement.
demo_0002.limit: Sparse two-view samples bracket the transfer; contact onset and depth remain unknown.

demo_0003.observation: Quarter-turned source near upper edge; fingers carry it toward square, then withdraw after upright placement.
demo_0003.limit: Some source/approach content is near the frame boundary; no complete contact timing.

demo_0004.observation: Source and early manipulation approach the upper image boundary; block is out of view in several intermediate samples, then placement/withdrawal are visible.
demo_0004.limit: This review does not independently resolve the initial orientation or lift from seven samples; earlier M0 labels remain attributed annotations, not fresh verification.

demo_0005.observation: Initially upright block left of goal is carried and placed upright; orientation change is not needed to describe its endpoint difference.
demo_0005.limit: No measured force, lift height or exact release time.

demo_0006.observation: Initially inverted block left of goal is gripped and reoriented during transport, then released upright in the square.
demo_0006.limit: This is included demo_0006; excluded review example 6 is demo_0017. Intermediate route/rotation timing is not mandated.

demo_0007.observation: Block begins in square quarter-turned; hand rotates it locally and withdraws with numeral upright.
demo_0007.limit: VIDEO10 already showed endpoint/static alternatives meet physical completion in this supplied-controller correction; no required intermediate path established.

demo_0009.observation: Block starts inverted in square; fingers reorient it, then leave an upright block at the target.
demo_0009.limit: Final yaw change is apparent from endpoints; specific lifting/rotation path is not an independent task requirement.

demo_0011.observation: Another inverted in-square start followed by local finger-supported reorientation and withdrawal.
demo_0011.limit: No second actor, external intervention or required special route is established.

demo_0012.observation: Left/upright source, hand-held intermediate block, then transport and upright placement. User-labelled pause/resume; seven-frame review alone does not measure a pause duration.
demo_0012.limit: VIDEO07 has finer sampled evidence of reduced progress and resumption; neither it nor the task specification makes waiting mandatory.

demo_0013.observation: Source upper-left; fingers lift and visibly tilt/reorient the block during the transfer before placing it upright.
demo_0013.limit: Tilt and pace are observed human motion; no independent requirement to reproduce that out-of-plane excursion.

demo_0014.observation: Left/oblique start, hand-held transport and lowering to the square, then withdrawal; user-labelled pause/resume.
demo_0014.limit: Lowering is visible; a pause is not inferred from a stationary overhead centroid. Exact support-transfer time unknown.

demo_0015.observation: Upper-right source, grasp and elevated transfer, then placement/withdrawal. Starting side differs from the original left-start description.
demo_0015.limit: No long pause established by this sampled panel; keep user intent. Hand occlusion obscures part of the numeral and contact.

demo_0016.observation: Source below square and oblique/inverted; fingers transfer and reorient it, then release at the square.
demo_0016.limit: Keep actual below-target source rather than inventing a left start. No calibrated 3D trajectory.

demo_0018.observation: Correct-looking block remains in the square and no hand/manipulation is visible at all seven inspected paired instants.
demo_0018.limit: Samples support no-action intent; they do not prove zero movement between every frame. Goal recognition can already use an initial goal observation.

demo_0019.observation: Second completed example: upright block in square, unchanged and hand-free at the seven inspected paired instants.
demo_0019.limit: Same no-action limitation as demo_0018; short stationary take is not an independent manipulation trial.
